summary.title: Embodied-R1.5: Evolving Physical Intelligence via Embodied Foundation Models

details: Existing embodied models cover only fragments of the capability spectrum (cognition, planning, or pointing), and heterogeneous multi-task joint training makes capabilities erode one another; closed-loop long-horizon autonomy is rarely validated.

Embodied-R1.5: a single 8B VLM that unifies three embodied capability dimensions — spatial cognition/reasoning, task planning & failure correction, and pointing/trajectory grounding — with all outputs (text, normalized point coordinates, traces) emitted as plain text tokens.

Trained via SFT then multi-task-balanced RL with verifiable rewards: advantages normalized by within-group mean but whole-batch std (plus difficulty-aware and dynamic group filtering) to remove cross-task reward-scale dominance; three automated pipelines generate the missing data (tabletop 3D-scene-graph spatial QA, perturbation-generated failure detection/localization/correction QA, affordance & 2D/3D trace annotations).
Planner-Grounder-Corrector (PGC) closed loop: one model instance asynchronously serves as planner, grounder, and corrector over a FIFO memory, with the harness containing no reasoning logic.

34 datasets, >15B tokens; proprietary additions: ER1.5-Spatial (~20K, MoGe-2 metric depth + Grounded-SAM-2 + RANSAC plane alignment on Bridge/DROID/Fractal images), ER1.5-Correction (~800K, five plan perturbation operators plus video truncation and physics-engine perturbation), ER1.5-Pointing (~400K affordance and end-effector/object trace data); general VQA data as anti-forgetting regularization.
SFT: Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct backbone, full-parameter (vision encoder unfrozen), 1 epoch, lr 2e-6 cosine, global batch 512, 8192 context.

RFT: GRPO variant on ~200K medium-difficulty samples, n=8 rollouts, lr 3e-6, KL-in-reward beta=0.01, clip 0.2/0.28, 2 epochs; five reward families (exact match, IoU, point-distance with piecewise-linear decay, trajectory RMSE/depth MAE, reward-model semantic similarity) plus 0.1-weighted format reward; no forced reasoning chain (adaptive thinking).

Embodied-R1.5-VLA: DiT-B flow-matching action expert cross-attending to VLM hidden states (2048-d), 32 future query tokens, 7-D actions, 4-step Euler inference; AdamW, action lr 1e-4 / VLM lr 1e-5, batch 128 on 8 H20 GPUs, 80K steps, no action pretraining; built on starVLA.

24 embodied VLM benchmarks via the released EmbodiedEvalKit (unified parsing/normalization of points, boxes, traces): planning/correction (RoboVQA, EgoPlan-2, Cosmos-Reason, RoboFAC), pointing (Where2Place, RefSpatial, Part-Afford, PointBench, Pixmo-Point, etc.), traces (ShareRobot-V, VABench-V, PIO-S3), cognition (ERQA, OpenEQA, SAT, RoboSpatial, VSIBench, BLINK), plus 7 general vision benchmarks.
Manipulation: SimplerEnv (Google Robot VM/VA, WidowX), LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, ManiSkill-Affordance (30 articulated categories, ManipLLM protocol), zero-shot RoboTwin2.0 (7 tasks, demo_randomized).

Real robots: Xarm6, ARX Lift2s, Realman RM75; five zero-shot task categories (6 trials each) plus four long-horizon PGC demos (milk tea 10 steps, cup stacking, sweeping, shelf picking) and human-perturbation recovery.

Baselines: GPT-4o/GPT-5.4, Gemini-2.5-Pro, Qwen3-VL-8B, InternVL3.5-8B, Molmo-D-7B; Gemini-Robotics-ER-1.5, RoboBrain-2.0-7B, Mimo-Embodied, Pelican-VL, Magma, Embodied-R1; VLA: pi0, pi0-FAST, pi0.5, OpenVLA(-OFT), GR00T-N1.5/N1.6, SpatialVLA, RDT, Diffusion Policy; affordance: Where2Act, Implicit3D, ManipLLM.

Ablations: SFT-only vs SFT+RFT; vanilla GRPO vs EMA-GRPO vs no difficulty filtering vs full recipe; Embodied-R1.5 vs Qwen3-VL-8B backbone paired with GR00T and OpenVLA-OFT action experts on LIBERO across training steps.

key_findings.finding: A single 8B unified model attains state of the art on most embodied VLM benchmarks, with the largest margins in pointing and planning/correction.
key_findings.evidence: SOTA on 16 of 24 benchmarks; 70.4% average on 21 accuracy-based benchmarks, +17.0% over Gemini-Robotics-ER-1.5 and +21.7% over GPT-5.4; pointing average 72.8 (SOTA on all 9 pointing benchmarks, e.g., Part-Afford 82.9, Where2Place 74.0), planning average 65.3 (RoboFAC 77.2, EgoPlan-2 53.8, +24.0pp over Gemini-Robotics-ER-1.5), cognition average 70.2; general vision benchmarks essentially unchanged versus Qwen3-VL-8B.

key_findings.finding: Internalized embodied reasoning can substitute for large-scale action pretraining in downstream VLA learning.
key_findings.evidence: With no action pretraining, Embodied-R1.5-VLA reaches 92.4% on SimplerEnv Google Robot Visual Matching (vs 72.7% for pi0.5, 97.2% vs 46.6% on the hardest drawer+apple task), 71.5% Variant Aggregation, 74.0% WidowX, 97.3% on LIBERO (exceeding pretrained OpenVLA-OFT 97.1%, while pi0.5 drops 96.9->93.6 and OpenVLA-OFT 97.1->91.9 without pretraining), and 76.0% on LIBERO-Plus (+6.4pp over OpenVLA-OFT, best on 6 of 7 shifts).

key_findings.finding: The embodied backbone itself, not the action head, drives the VLA gains, giving faster convergence and a persistent advantage.
key_findings.evidence: On LIBERO, Embodied-R1.5 vs Qwen3-VL-8B backbone: 92.0% vs 82.0% at 10K steps with GR00T action expert (+10pp) and 97.0% vs 96.0% at 80K steps, with the same trend for the OpenVLA-OFT action expert.

key_findings.finding: The PGC closed loop enables zero-shot long-horizon autonomy and recovery that prior embodied models fail at entirely.
key_findings.evidence: Zero-shot real-robot results (6 trials/task): Tool Affordance 100% vs 33.3% for Embodied-R1 and RoboBrain 2.0, Cup Disassembly 66.6% vs 0% for both baselines, Door Open 16.6% vs 0%; four 5-10 step tasks (milk tea, cup stacking, sweeping, shelf picking) complete fully autonomously, and the corrector recovers from repeated human relocation of target/plate mid-execution.

key_findings.finding: Multi-task balanced RL with global-batch reward normalization plus difficulty-aware filtering outperforms vanilla and per-task-EMA GRPO, and RFT adds consistent gains over SFT.
key_findings.evidence: RFT over SFT-only: +3.8pp pointing, +2.7pp planning, +1.3pp cognition; ablation shows the full recipe best balanced across dimensions (70.2/65.3/72.8) with difficulty-aware filtering contributing the most and EMA-GRPO only marginally above vanilla GRPO.
